what_the_evidence_actually_supports: Two candidate causes and this comparison cannot separate them. (a) family_cave_diagnose_arms perturbs the op sequence somewhere that family_topk_shift_arms does not - the topk twin is bit-identical on the same box, so the pattern itself is not the problem. (b) 27b diagnose is numerically fragile to ANY op-order perturbation. Magnitudes support this: median non-zero delta on lpC_single is 0.0093, and bf16 at |lp| ~ 5-10 has ulp ~ 0.02, so the typical difference is SUB-ULP accumulation noise, not a logic error - though M0 and RC_effect reach 0.37-0.44, which is many ulp. Note the earlier CROSS-BOX 27b divergence was the same magnitude (median 0.012 on lpC_single), so same-box-different-script and different-box-same-script are indistinguishable in size.
why_the_rider_does_not_contradict_this: out/../r1_27b_determinism_rider = WITHIN_BOX_DETERMINISTIC compared family_cave_diagnose against ITSELF twice on one box: 0 of 14 fields. So two invocations of the SAME code are bit-identical, and two invocations of DIFFERENT code are not. That is consistent with an op-order sensitivity and inconsistent with process-level nondeterminism.
route_to_restoring_the_listen_numbers: Find the op-order difference between family_cave_diagnose and family_cave_diagnose_arms - a diff of the forward-call sequence, not of the arithmetic - fix it, and re-run this same-box test. The topk twin is the existence proof that a neutral re-parameterisation of this shape is achievable.
